title: Compelling Tribute (Imperial)
description: Legate Rikke sends you to Mistveil Keep to find incriminating evidence on Anuriel, the Jarl of Riften's steward, who has ties to the Thieves Guild. After blackmailing Anuriel for intelligence on a Stormcloak shipment, you rendezvous with Hadvar's scouts to ambush the caravan and seize the weapons and gold.

base_facts: I am Legate Rikke of the Imperial Legion, stationed at the Rift Imperial Camp.
Anuriel, steward to the Jarl of Riften, is involved with the Thieves Guild.
I need evidence of Anuriel's corruption to leverage her into cooperating with the Empire.
I have Imperial scouts positioned near where the Stormcloak wagon travels.

REPORT_INTEL: The player has informed me about a large shipment of Stormcloak gold and weapons being transported by wagon near Windhelm.
I have sent the player to meet our scouts and capture the shipment.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The player successfully captured the Stormcloak shipment. I will send men to collect the prize and forward the coin to Solitude.
Player reports to Hadvar after the battle; quest completes with the shipment captured.
Return to Legate Rikke to receive the leveled gold reward only when you want to start the next quest in the series and skip the reward when the game doesn't prompt you to return to her.
Leaving the area and waiting for a few in-game days before trying to talk to him again can allow you to finally report to him.

base_facts: I am Anuriel, steward to the Jarl of Riften at Mistveil Keep.
I have connections to the Thieves Guild that I wish to keep secret.

BLACKMAIL_ANURIEL: The player has found my incriminating letter and confronted me with it.
I revealed information about a large Stormcloak shipment of gold and weapons traveling by wagon near Windhelm in exchange for their silence.

base_facts: I am Hadvar, an Imperial soldier commanding a scouting party in the Rift.
I have been tracking a Stormcloak wagon carrying gold and weapons.

AMBUSH_CARAVAN: The player and I ambushed the Stormcloak caravan together.
We took out the sentry and overpowered the rebel guards to seize the shipment.

beats.comment: Player is sent to Mistveil Keep to find incriminating evidence on Anuriel.
Player finds the incriminating letter and confronts Anuriel, who reveals intel about the Stormcloak shipment.

keywords: I know about the Thieves Guild

beats.comment: Player reports the wagon intel to Rikke, who sends them to meet the scouts.

keywords: Anuriel told me about a wagon

beats.comment: Player meets Hadvar's scouts, ambushes the Stormcloak sentry, and takes over the caravan.
Player reports to Hadvar after the battle; quest completes with the shipment captured.
